question: What changed after the decision to freeze an interface, and how much churn followed?
sql:
WITH freeze_commit AS (
    SELECT commit_sha, authored_date, touched_components
    FROM v_commit
    WHERE subject ILIKE '%freeze%' AND subject ILIKE '%interface%'
    ORDER BY authored_date
    LIMIT 1
),
freeze_components AS (
    SELECT UNNEST(touched_components) AS component, authored_date AS freeze_date
    FROM freeze_commit
)
SELECT
    fc.component AS frozen_component,
    fc.freeze_date AS freeze_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT vcf.commit_sha) AS commits_after_freeze,
    SUM(vcf.insertions + vcf.deletions) AS churn_after_freeze
FROM freeze_components fc
JOIN v_commit_file vcf
    ON vcf.component = fc.component
    AND vcf.authored_date > fc.freeze_date
GROUP BY fc.component, fc.freeze_date
ORDER BY churn_after_freeze DESC
